facts.text: Caroline expressed feeling proud and grateful for the support and community around her.

evidence.quote: I felt so proud and grateful - the vibes were amazing and it was comforting to know I'm not alone and have a great community around me.

facts.text: Caroline mentioned that realizing she can be herself without fear and having the courage to transition was the best part of being around supportive people.

evidence.quote: Realizing I can be me without fear and having the courage to transition was the best part. It's so freeing to express myself authentically and have people back me up.

facts.text: Melanie acknowledged Caroline's courage to be herself and noted its importance for mental health and finding peace.

evidence.quote: That's awesome, Caro! You've found the courage to be yourself - that's important for our mental health and finding peace.
